Positive RGB dimensions and exact declared byte count
Bounded complete zlib stream without trailing data
Exact decoded byte count and original pixel SHA-256

unchanged_by_this_change: Native observations and info returned by environment steps
Retrieval, model calls and CEM settings
Original query identities and random seeds
